_meta.about: Kling generations for the companion portraits (companions.md 11.5 / C9) and the six Part 2 companions (world2.md 14). Separate from tools/kling/manifest.json on purpose (another agent appends to that file).
_meta.processing: same as existing 3:4 portraits (tools/kling/clean_watermark.py portrait branch): crop bottom 5.5% (130 px; the KlingAI 3.0 Omni mark starts at 95.3% of the height) -> 1760x2238 -> LANCZOS resize to 761x968 -> WebP quality 82, method 6 (all files <= 90 KB so no quality step-down was needed). Files are NOT listed in tools/kling/cleaned.json, so re-running clean_watermark.py would crop them a second time.
_meta.iconFocus: square crop for the 40 px HUD circles: centre (x * width, y * height), side s * width, all in the final 761x968 image
